summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 UI-consistency changes (notification sub-cards, theme sub-card, uniform switch size). All 3 changes are programmatically VERIFIED via DOM/computed-style inspection in the Expo web preview at localhost:3000. CHANGE 1: master 'Allow notifications' row stays flat at top of the outer NOTIFICATIONS card; once master is ON each of the 3 notification types (Dealer route reminders, Borrowed-tool overdue reminders, Payment Notifications) renders inside its OWN notifGroup wrapper with boxShadow (4px+6px black drop shadow), borderRadius 10px, borderWidth 2px and surface background — i.e. they read as distinct floating sub-cards (test row at the bottom is correctly flat). CHANGE 2: tapping the Theme accordion row opens an optGroup wrapper that contains ALL 4 appearance options (industrial, industrial-pink, light, dark) as children of one container with boxShadow + borderRadius 10px + borderWidth 2px — single floating sub-card. CHANGE 3: every AppSwitch on every screen measures exactly 31.2 × 15.6 px and reports transform matrix(0.78, 0, 0, 0.78, 0, 0). 10 switches on /more, 14 in the Home Screen Rows modal (master+notifications+settings switches PLUS the 9 home-row toggles), 1 on /personal-info — and in EVERY scope, total document role=switch count equals the count of scale(0.78) AppSwitches, i.e. no rogue raw <Switch> component is left. /tool/edit sections were collapsed so its warranty/consumable switches were not in the DOM at the time, but source verifies AppSwitch is the only switch used there (edit.tsx:985, edit.tsx:1199, [id].tsx:2908). Known RN-Web limitation: Playwright cannot programmatically flip the Switch via click() — verification was done by writing prefs into AsyncStorage (toolbox_prefs_v2) and re-rendering, as suggested in the agent-to-agent note. One unrelated pre-existing issue surfaced: navigating directly to /tool/edit threw a dev-overlay 'Uncaught Error: Not authenticated' from src/api.ts:382 (status 402 'Free tier'), which is unrelated to these 3 UI changes but worth flagging.

opt_group_after_open.verdict: single floating sub-card containing all 4 appearance options ✓

tool_edit_screen.note: sections were collapsed so warranty/consumable toggles not mounted at inspection time; source confirms AppSwitch is used (edit.tsx:985, edit.tsx:1199) — no raw <Switch> in tool screens (grep across /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src returned only AppSwitch usages plus the single raw Switch inside AppSwitch.tsx itself)

change_3_uniform_switch_size.code_audit: grep -rn '<Switch\b' returned zero matches outside /app/frontend/src/components/AppSwitch.tsx — every consumer uses <AppSwitch>

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not part of this review): direct navigation to /tool/edit can throw a dev-overlay 'Uncaught Error: Not authenticated' from src/api.ts:382 (status 402 'Free tier'). Unrelated to these 3 UI changes but worth a look on a future pass — the route should surface paywall UI instead of raising in api.ts.

NotificationsSettingsSection.tsx still declares a local styles.miniSwitch with transform scale(0.78) (line 827-829) and applies it on top of every AppSwitch (style={styles.miniSwitch}). Because AppSwitch enforces its own scale 0.78 LAST (component appends transform after caller style), the duplicate has no visible effect, but it is dead code and slightly misleading — caller-side scale should be removed now that the wrapper enforces it. Verified visually: all 10 switches on /more still measure exactly 31.2×15.6 so nothing is broken.
seed_data_creation: Set notifications_master_enabled, dealer_notifications_enabled, borrow_reminders_enabled, payment_notifications_enabled to true in localStorage key 'toolbox_prefs_v2' to force the 3 notification sub-cards to render (Playwright cannot flip RN-Web Switch via UI — same limitation documented in the agent-to-agent note).

To reproduce: log in with MechanicLTZ@gmail.com / Blue321!, then in DevTools set localStorage['toolbox_prefs_v2'] = JSON.stringify({...current, notifications_master_enabled:true, dealer_notifications_enabled:true, borrow_reminders_enabled:true, payment_notifications_enabled:true}) and refresh /more to see the 3 floating notification sub-cards.
